question: Find the sum of money invested by a man in a scheme which offers Compound Interest(compounding annually) at a 6% rate of interest per annum if Compound Interest for 2 years is Rs. 618.
solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 6% ; Time = 2 years

Compound interest (C.I) = Rs.618

**Formula used:**

A = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

C.I = A - P

Where, A = Amount ; P = Principal ; R = Rate ; T = Time

**Calculation:**

Amount - principal = Compound interest (C.I)

⇒ P × {1 + (R/100)}T - P = 618
